statement: An optional effect whose text says "If" can be activated even when its event wasn't the last thing to happen; one whose text says "When" can only if it was. A Trap Card activated on an "If" event is the same, and a trigger on a phase has no event to miss.

sources.by: Claude (the reader's reading of Problem-Solving Card Text)
